name: Agent-Chorus Capability Reel Story Film
description: A short launch film that repeats one prompt across four product surfaces, turning a request into visible work. Built for social feeds with hard cuts, readable interface moments, and proof grounded in the material you provide.
whatYouGet: Scene timing, on-screen copy, and an evidence ledger
goodFit: A founder introducing a workflow product
An app developer showing a new capability
A marketing manager preparing a social launch
notFor: A reel built around unverified metrics
requiredInputs: Four product states or enough verified detail to depict them
A real artifact or outcome and a call to action

faq.q: Do I need recordings of every screen?
faq.a: No. Screenshots or verified interface details are enough for an HTML/CSS reconstruction. Any invented details are identified as illustrative.

faq.q: Can the film include results or customer quotes?
faq.a: Yes, when you provide the source and approve the wording. Otherwise the film uses a visible workflow artifact as proof.

demoPrompt: /sl-agent-chorus-capability-reel-story-film Make a 29-second 16:9 social launch film for fictional workspace Project Desk. Open with “One request. Four surfaces.” and “A launch update is waiting.” Show a feature request moving through Capture, Plan, Build, and Publish, then an illustrative release checklist. Close with “View the workflow.” Use the skill’s Four-Surface Chorus style.
followUpPrompts: Make the first three seconds clearer without adding another scene.
Replace the illustrative proof with this approved release screenshot and update the evidence ledger.
externalCostNote: No external services or generation models. Renders locally.
